rationale: Raw-source financial highlights explicitly report a $1.20 per-share distribution for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and a 7.76% net-investment-income ratio. The distribution is therefore source-supported, and its unusually large size relative to recurring income explains the F16 heuristic breach. F16 is only a weak distribution-versus-income heuristic; it does not establish that either source-backed field is erroneous. The check is the false alarm, driven by a legitimate exceptional distribution rather than an extraction defect.
